attr.title: Tunics!
attr.desc: A roguelike Zelda-style action RPG built with the Solarus engine, where players fight through randomly generated, increasingly difficult dungeons using classic Zelda-inspired items and skills. It features permadeath
attr.inst: Get the .solarus file for this port by downloading Tunics! fromhttps://solarus-games.org/games/tunics/, then move it into ports/tunics_pm folder.
